variants.A: Original design for an anti-gravity arcade racing game (not based on any existing game). A long streamlined teardrop hover racer in polished silver chrome and ice blue with pale cyan glowing seams, a rounded comet-like nose, a single tall swept tail fin, one big round rear thruster flanked by two slim outrigger pods on thin struts, a long low canopy. No wheels: it hovers. Stylized clean hard-surface model, glossy painted panels with thin glowing neon seams, Tron and Ready Player One cyberpunk flavour. Isolated on a pure white background, the whole machine in frame with margin, three-quarter front view from slightly above, soft even studio light, no text, no logos, no numbers, no driver visible, no shadow clutter.
